Independent bounded replay: exhaust ordered pairs of n×n matrices over F_q, directly compare XY−YX with Y², then independently convolve the rational Euler factors through degree n. (q,n)=(2,2),(2,3),(3,2) gave 40, 2192, 153; normalized coefficients were 20/3, 274/21, 51/16 respectively.
correctness.rationale: Trace on each individual Jordan diagonal block gives e a²=0, including when the same eigenvalue appears in more than one block. Finite-field separability preserves lengths upon splitting a primary block. The derivation t²d/dt descends to every allowed cyclic summand and its commutator with multiplication by t is multiplication by t². Thus each nonempty fiber is a translate of the commuting algebra with the stated dimension (sum of pairwise minima, or squared column lengths); empty and nilpotent cases are included. The fiber weight cancels the q-power of the centralizer-unit order by orbit–stabilizer. Summing independent multiplicities by Euler's identity, then using polynomial unique factorization for sizes divisible by p, gives the normalized product, with constant coefficient 1. At n=p the nonnilpotent types are single length-p blocks with q−1 choices of eigenvalue and weight q/(q−1), giving qG_p(q).
residual_risks: Independent enumeration is bounded to the listed cases; all dimensions and extension fields rely on the proof. Frozen F4 result is recorded evidence, not part of the independent replay.
